author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12 (queue items 1 and 2): the commons root is resolved by hand all over Cairn. Six production sites default to the home-relative path ~/dev/src/CairnCommons, which does not exist on Windows (the clone is the sibling C:/automation/local/CairnCommons): installer.py:18, ticket_inspector/inspector.py:23 and :25, operator_inbox/inbox.py:26, skill_block/skill_block.py:409, tester/hollow.py:110-111. About 35 more sites inline the sibling form _REPO.parent / CairnCommons. cairn/tools/base/address.py already holds ROOTS['commons'], a leaf that imports only pathlib. Separately, installer.install() calls gather_host_seams, whose iterdir() raises FileNotFoundError when the commons is absent, so a dry run on a bare box is a traceback.
